artworks.name: hero_wide
artworks.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: original source illustration for Kiln Auto Loot, with absolutely NO TEXT.
Create an extremely wide 3:1 panoramic painting, target 3072x1024. A mossy ruined stone courtyard at blue-hour dusk, on the edge of a misty blue-teal forest; low violet fog glows softly in the distant archways. Across the middle-right courtyard, show broken wooden barrels and crates with a few flying splinters, an opened low stone chest, pottery shards, glowing mushrooms, a berry bush, cut logs, ore stones, and a few small faceted gems. From each resource cluster, a soft warm ember-gold light trail curls toward ONE bright warm glowing elliptical ring on the path at centre-right, x about 70 percent. Loose resources gently float along these curving trails, a quiet whirl of collected treasure. The ring marks the place of an unseen traveller; there is NO person or creature. The ring is light on ordinary mossy paving, no altar or pedestal. Keep the objects individually recognizable, with restrained luminous trails rather than an explosion.
Composition: wide cinematic eye-level panorama, quiet dark teal negative space over the entire LEFT THIRD for a title that will be added later. Place the courtyard action and resource clusters across x=40 to 92 percent. Keep ALL important objects, the chest, the broken barrels, and the complete glowing ring inside the MIDDLE 60 PERCENT of the image HEIGHT, y=20 to 80 percent, so they all survive a centred 4:1 banner crop. Bottom and top margins are atmospheric moss and forest with no essential details. Keep the glowing ring modest in height, well inside that safe band. Balanced and appealing even without text.
Style: newly invented stylized painterly fantasy concept art, expressive visible brush shapes, soft volumetric light, atmospheric depth, handcrafted materials, warm ember gold against cool teal and violet, gentle magical motion and a welcoming survival-crafting mood. All artwork must be NEW ORIGINAL ART, no copied game art or reference pixels.
Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, runes, logos, UI, watermarks, brands, trademarks, people, creatures, faces, silhouettes of characters, or photorealism.
artworks.preparation: Resampled to target pixel size with Pillow Lanczos; no content changes.
